description: Map a three.js project from its files in one call: bundler and framework (Vite, Next, React Three Fiber, plain import map), installed three release vs package.json and @types/three, the libraries around it, pages and how they load three, every file that uses three with what it creates (renderer, cameras, lights, controls, loaders, composer) and where its animation loop is, renderer settings (tone mapping, colour space, shadows, pixel ratio) and the assets the code loads with problems. Call it once before your first edit. `detail` full adds imports per file, every asset problem and the glTF extensions of each model. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_scan
title: Map the three.js project
